comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-001 (medium, acceptance-first). Required set = low ∪ {unit-tests, acceptance-tests, regression} per risk-gate-matrix.md; requirement-traceability is not required at medium and is therefore omitted from this contract's checks array (matching the epic-159-pillar-c/T-001.contract.json precedent). Populated from the independent quality-gate evaluator's own verification results, recorded verbatim in reports/quality-gate/2026-07-23T003000Z.md (Run ID RUN-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-qg-T-001-seq0344, launched under the reserved identity-ledger sequence 344, review-context manifest reports/review-context/pending-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-sdd-evaluator-T-001-seq0344-manifest.json): the evaluator independently reran the bash and PowerShell capability-registry-schema suites in both RED (--red-check/-RedCheck) and GREEN modes (exit 0 both lanes; RED confirmed all 16 reject fixtures are non-vacuous), additionally stood up an isolated venv with the real jsonschema package and validated contracts/capability-registry.schema.json's Draft7Validator against the canonical instance plus all 22 fixtures with zero disagreements against this task's own jq/PowerShell re-implementation, reran check-risk/check-task-state/check-workflow-state/check-placeholders (all PASS), confirmed the live .github/workflows/test.yml is byte-identical across the T-001 commits and the staged human-copy candidate matches its MANIFEST.sha256 entry, and sampled the implementation report's Outputs-table hashes. Verdict: PASS, zero Critical, zero Major, three Minor (non-blocking: (1) the canonical instance's illustrative implementation_ref names a script that does not yet exist, forwarded to T-004 per design.md's INV-002 sanction; (2) the human-copy staging mechanism used a scratchpad-only helper script to work around sdd-hook-guard's over-broad command-text deny on the human-copy path, recorded as a governance note, not a defect -- live protected file confirmed byte-unchanged; (3) the pre-existing, T-001-unrelated tests/turn-first-workflow.tests.sh template-drift failure). Shell stack waives the three compile-oriented checks (lint/typecheck/build) -- this task's deliverables are a JSON Schema contract, two JSON data files, and shell/PowerShell test-infrastructure files with no compile toolchain in this repository. Evidence for unit-tests/acceptance-tests/regression/placeholder-scan/task-state-check below points at reports/quality-gate/2026-07-23T003000Z.md (the evaluator's own persisted, hash-verified verification-results table) as the primary quality-gate-stage evidence, alongside this task's own implementer-authored RED/GREEN logs under specs/epic-190-a2-capability-registry/verification/T-001/ which the evaluator independently reran and confirmed reproduce identically.
